---
title: "ParaView Plot Types"
description: "Choosing and configuring common ParaView visualizations for CFD results."
categories: [Software, ParaView]
---

ParaView offers many ways to look at simulation results, and picking the right one depends on what
you want to show: a contour plot to show the overall structure of a field, streamlines or glyphs to
show a velocity field, or a line plot to extract quantitative profiles for comparison with
experimental data.
